```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(scRepertoire)
library(VDJdive)
library(ggpubr)
library(ECLIPSE)

source("/home/ecb86/Desktop/R_tools/VDJdive_ECLIPSE_paperFunctions.R")
set.seed(16)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                         Pre-Processing                               ###
############################################################################

braun <- readRDS("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/processed/braun_cancer_cell_seurat.rds")

braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% separate(Sample, into = c("donor", "tissue"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")
braun@meta.data <- braun@meta.data %>% mutate(tissue = case_when(
                                                                 tissue %in% c("T", "T2") ~ "Tumor",
                                                                 tissue == "N" ~ "Normal",
                                                                 tissue %in% c("M", "V")  ~ "Other"))

cd8 <- subset(braun, subset = ClusterName_TCells %in% c("Treg", "Activated CD4.1", "Activated CD4.2", "CD4 TCM.1", "CD4 TCM.2", "Mito-high T cells", "-1"), invert = TRUE)

dirs <- list.files("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/TCR/cellranger_output_indexHoppingRemoved", recursive = TRUE, pattern = "all_contig_annotations\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
dirs <- dirs[!str_detect(dirs, "SC_VDJ_ASSEMBLER_CS")]
dirs <- str_replace(dirs, "all.*$", "")

matching <- read.csv("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/ecb86/sc_datasets/braun_cancer_cell/braun_matching2.csv")
matching <- matching %>% filter(Sample != "")

cd8@meta.data <- cd8@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
cd8@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8@meta.data)
rownames(cd8@meta.data) <- cd8$Cell_barcode
cd8$Cell_Barcode <- str_replace(cd8$Cell_barcode, "\\-.*$", "-1")

ElbowPlot(cd8, ndims = 50)
cd8 <- RunUMAP(cd8, dims = 1:30)

cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "PMCH+ terminally Exhausted CD8.1"] <- "PMCH+ terminally \n Exhausted CD8.1"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.2"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.2"
cd8$ClusterName_TCells[cd8$ClusterName_TCells == "Terminally exhausted CD8.3"] <- "Terminally \n exhausted CD8.3"

cd8s <- ECLIPSE(contig_folder_paths = dirs, 
                contig_type = "all", 
                seurat_object = cd8, 
                batch = "index", 
                donor = "donor", 
                group = "donor", 
                original_barcode = "Cell_Barcode")

cd8s <- tcrDoubletDetect(cd8s)
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure S4A                               ###
############################################################################

df <- compareClones(cd8s, clusters = "ClusterName_TCells", cloneThresh = 100, cloneClassThresh = 10)

df2 <- df[[1]] %>% group_by(Sample, class) %>% summarise(mn_count = mean(nCount_RNA),
                                                         mn_feat = mean(nFeature_RNA),
                                                         md_count = median(nCount_RNA),
                                                         md_feat = median(nFeature_RNA),
                                                         count = n()) %>% ungroup()

slim <- df2 %>% filter(class != "Other" & count >= 3)

slim2 <- slim %>% ungroup() %>%
                    select(Sample, class, md_count) %>%
                    pivot_wider(
                                names_from = class,
                                values_from = md_count)

results <- runPairedTests(slim2, groups = c("1°\n&\n2°", "NA", "2°", "1°"), adjustment_method = "fdr", runPaired = TRUE)
results$y.position <- c(6500, 7000, 7500, 7500, 8000, 8500)

data <- as.data.frame(slim2)
data <- data[!is.na(data[, "NA"]) & !is.na(data[, "1°\n&\n2°"]), ]
test <- wilcox.test(data[, "NA"], data[, "1°\n&\n2°"], paired = TRUE)

slim$class <- factor(slim$class, levels = c("1°\n&\n2°", "1°", "2°", "NA"))
slim <- slim %>% arrange(class)

makeBoxplot(slim, 
            x = "class", 
            y = "md_count", 
            group = "Sample", 
            x_title = "Chains expressed", 
            y_title = "Median RNA counts",
            pval = results, 
            colors = c("tomato", "grey60", "slateblue3", "peru"),
            ylim = c(1500, 8600),
            x_text = c("Both bitypic", "Major bitypic", "Minor bitypic", "Only monotypic"))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/s4a.pdf", width = 2, height = 2.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

```

```{r}
############################################################################
```

```{r}
############################################################################

meta <- read.csv("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/paper_realigned/scDblFinder_output_realigned.csv")

cd8s@meta.data <- cd8s@meta.data %>% left_join(meta, by = "Cell_barcode")
cd8s@meta.data <- as.data.frame(cd8s@meta.data)
rownames(cd8s@meta.data) <- cd8s$Cell_barcode

df <- cd8s@meta.data %>% mutate(specialClone = case_when(
                                                         cloneCallSource == "VDJdive" & str_detect(CTaa, ":::") ~ "Combo",
                                                         cloneCallSource == "VDJdive" & !str_detect(CTaa, ":::") ~ "Regular",
                                                         cloneCallSource == "scRepertoire" ~ "Ambiguous",
                                                         is.na(cloneCallSource) ~ "No TCR"))

db <- df %>% group_by(Sample, specialClone) %>% summarise(count = n(),
                                                          md_score = median(scDblFinder.score),
                                                          mn_score = mean(scDblFinder.score))

db <- db %>% filter(count >= 3)

db2 <- db %>% ungroup() %>% select(Sample, specialClone, md_score) %>%
                            pivot_wider(names_from = specialClone,
                                        values_from = md_score)

results <- runPairedTests(db2, groups = c("Regular", "No TCR", "Ambiguous", "Combo"), adjustment_method = "fdr", runPaired = TRUE)
results$y.position <- c(0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85)

db$specialClone <- factor(db$specialClone, levels = c("Regular", "Combo", "Ambiguous", "No TCR"))
db <- db %>% arrange(specialClone)

makeBoxplot(db, 
            x = "specialClone", 
            y = "md_score", 
            group = "Sample", 
            x_title = "Type of clone", 
            y_title = "Median doublet score",
            pval = results, 
            colors = c("darkolivegreen", "magenta4", "sienna4", "turquoise4"),
```

```{r}
############################################################################
###                             Figure S4G                               ###
############################################################################
clones <- cd8s@meta.data %>% filter(!is.na(CTaa)) %>%
                             group_by(donor, CTaa, cloneCallSource) %>%
                             summarise(count = n())

clones2 <- clones %>% filter(cloneCallSource == "VDJdive") %>%
                      arrange(desc(count)) %>%
                      group_by(donor) %>%
                      mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
                      ungroup()


clones2 <- clones2 %>% filter(row_num <= 30) %>%
                       group_by(donor) %>%
                       summarise(mn_size = mean(count),
                                 md_size = median(count),
                                 pct_3 = 100 * sum(str_detect(CTaa, ":::")) / n(),
                                 md_pct_rep = median(count) * 100 / sum(count),
                                 mn_pct_rep = mean(count) * 100 / sum(count))

clones_other <- clones %>% arrange(desc(count)) %>%
                           group_by(donor) %>%
                           mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
                           ungroup()

clones_other <- clones_other %>% group_by(donor) %>%
                                 summarise(pct_top10 = 100 * sum(count[row_num <= 10]) / sum(count)) %>%
                                 ungroup()


                                            
div <- clonalDiversity(cd8s, group.by = "donor", cloneCall = "aa", exportTable = TRUE) %>% mutate(class = "tcrEclipse")

clones3 <- clones2 %>% left_join(div, by = "donor")
clones3 <- clones3 %>% left_join(clones_other, by = "donor")

cor <- cor.test(clones3$inv.simpson, clones3$pct_3, method = "spearman")
lb <- paste0("Spearman's ρ = ", round(cor$estimate, 2), ",\np = ", round(cor$p.value, 3))

clones3 %>% ggplot(aes(x = inv.simpson, y = pct_3)) +
            geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "skyblue3") +
            geom_point(color = "black", size = 1.5, fill = "skyblue3", shape = 21, stroke = 0.3) +
            annotate(x = 27, y = 59.5, size = 1.7, "text", label = lb, color = "black") + 
            theme_bw() + 
            labs(x = "Inverse Simpson index", 
                 y = "% of large clones with\n3 TCR chains") +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
                  axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
                  panel.grid = element_blank(),
                  panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
                  axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                  axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm"),
                  axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1)),
                  axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 1))) +
            scale_x_continuous(guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE), expand = c(0.025, 0.025)) +
            scale_y_continuous(guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE))

ggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/s4g.pdf", width = 2.4, height = 2.3, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
direcs <- list.dirs("/nfs/roberts/pi/pi_db2475/lab_data/sc_assays/braun_cancer_cell_2021/raw/RNA/cellranger_outputs", full.names = TRUE)
direcs <- direcs[-1]

direcs
test <- str_replace(direcs, "^.*outputs\\/", "")

rna <- list()

rna <- lapply(direcs, Read10X)

for (i in 1:length(rna)) {
  colnames(rna[[i]]) <- paste(i, colnames(rna[[i]]), sep = "_")
}

rna2 <- do.call(cbind, rna)


seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(rna2)

seurat$barcodes <- rownames(seurat@meta.data)

donors <- str_replace(direcs, "^.*outputs\\/", "")
donors <- str_replace(donors, "\\/.*$", "")
donordf <- data.frame("orig.ident" = factor(c(1:28)), "Sample" = donors)
seurat@meta.data <- seurat@meta.data %>% left_join(donordf, by = "orig.ident")

seurat@meta.data <- as.data.frame(seurat@meta.data)
rownames(seurat@meta.data) <- seurat$barcodes

seurat@meta.data <- seurat@meta.data %>% left_join(matching[, 2:3], by = "Sample")
seurat@meta.data <- as.data.frame(seurat@meta.data)

seurat@meta.data <- seurat@meta.data %>% separate(Sample, into = c("donor", "tissue"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")
seurat@meta.data <- as.data.frame(seurat@meta.data)
rownames(seurat@meta.data) <- seurat$barcodes
seurat$orig_barcode <- str_replace(seurat$barcodes, "^.*_", "")




threeA <- pre2(contig_folder_paths = dirs, 
               contig_type = "all", 
               seurat_object = seurat, 
               batch = "index", 
               donor = "donor", 
               group = "donor", 
               original_barcode = "orig_barcode")


one <- threeA[[1]]
two <- threeA[[2]]

slim <- subset(two, barcodes %in% one$barcode)

clusters <- braun@meta.data %>% select(Cell_barcode, ClusterName_AllCells, ClusterName_ImmuneCells, ClusterName_TCells, ClusterName_MyeloidCells)

key <- braun@meta.data %>% mutate(suffix = str_replace(Cell_barcode, "^.*-", "")) %>%
                            group_by(suffix, Sample) %>%
                            summarise(count = n()) %>% ungroup()

slim@meta.data <- slim@meta.data %>% left_join(key[, 1:2], by = "Sample")
slim@meta.data <- slim@meta.data %>% mutate(Cell_barcode = str_replace(orig_barcode, "-.*$", paste0("-", suffix)))

slim@meta.data <- slim@meta.data %>% left_join(clusters, by = "Cell_barcode")

slim@meta.data <- slim@meta.data %>% mutate(inseurat = !is.na(ClusterName_AllCells))

slimmeta <- slim@meta.data %>% group_by(Sample) %>%
                          arrange(desc(nCount_RNA)) %>%
                          mutate(pos = row_number()) %>%
                          ungroup()

slimmeta <- slimmeta %>% mutate(nCount_RNA2 = case_when(

slimmeta %>% ggplot(aes(x = pos, y = nCount_RNA2)) +

              geom_hline(yintercept = 30) +

              facet_wrap(~Sample, scales = "free_x") +

slim@meta.data <- as.data.frame(slim@meta.data)
rownames(slim@meta.data) <- slim$barcodes

contigs <- combineTCR(one)
slim <- combineExpression(contigs, slim)

drops <- slim@meta.data %>% filter(nCount_RNA < 30 & nCount_RNA > 0) %>%
                            group_by(donor) %>%
                            mutate(donorCount = n()) %>%
                            group_by(donor, CTaa) %>%
                            summarise(pct = 100 * n() / first(donorCount),
                                      donor_count = first(donorCount),
                                      clone_count = n()) %>%
                            ungroup() %>%
                            arrange(desc(pct))


drops_barcodes <- slim@meta.data %>% filter(nCount_RNA < 30 & nCount_RNA > 0)

t_clones <- cd8s@meta.data %>% filter(!is.na(CTaa)) %>%
                               group_by(donor) %>%
                               mutate(donorSize = n()) %>%
                               group_by(donor, CTaa, cloneCallSource) %>%
                               summarise(pct = 100 * n() / first(donorSize),
                                         count = n(),
                                         donorCount = first(donorSize))

t_clones3 <- t_clones %>% filter(cloneCallSource == "VDJdive" & str_detect(CTaa, ":::"))


drops_chains <- one %>% filter(barcode %in% drops_barcodes$barcode) %>%
                        group_by(cdr3, donor, chain) %>%
                        summarise(count = n())

drops_chains <- drops_chains %>% group_by(donor) %>%
                                 arrange(desc(count)) %>%
                                 mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
                                 ungroup() %>%
                                 arrange(row_num)

t_clones <- t_clones %>% arrange(desc(count))
drops_chains2$match_count <- -1
drops_chains2$match_clone <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(drops_chains2)) {
  
  print(i)
  same_donor_clones <- t_clones %>% filter(donor == drops_chains2$donor[i] & cloneCallSource == "VDJdive")
  
  if (drops_chains2$chain[i] == "TRA") {
    
    matches <- str_detect(same_donor_clones$CTaa, paste0("^", drops_chains2$cdr3[i], "_|^", drops_chains2$cdr3[i], ":::|:::", drops_chains2$cdr3[i], "_"))
    drops_chains2$match_count[i] <- sum(matches)
    
    if (drops_chains2$match_count[i] > 0) {
        drops_chains2$match_clone[i] <- same_donor_clones$CTaa[which(matches)[[1]]]
    }
    
    
  } else if (drops_chains2$chain[i] == "TRB") {
    
    matches <- str_detect(same_donor_clones$CTaa, paste0("_", drops_chains2$cdr3[i], "$|_", drops_chains2$cdr3[i], ":::|:::", drops_chains2$cdr3[i], "$"))
    drops_chains2$match_count[i] <- sum(matches)
    
    if(drops_chains2$match_count[i] > 0) {
        drops_chains2$match_clone[i] <- same_donor_clones$CTaa[which(matches)[[1]]]
    }
    
  }
  
}
                                          

drops_chains2 <- drops_chains2 %>% mutate(three_chain = str_detect(match_clone, ":::"))



full <- slim@meta.data %>% filter(nCount_RNA < 30 & nCount_RNA > 0) %>% 
                           group_by(donor) %>%
                           summarise(donor_drop_count = n()) %>%
                           right_join(drops_chains2, by = "donor")


full$key <- paste(full$match_clone, full$donor)
full$key[str_detect(full$key, "^NA ")] <- NA

t_clones$key <- paste(t_clones$CTaa, t_clones$donor)

t_clones_slim <- t_clones %>% ungroup() %>% 
                              select(key,
                                     "pct_t_clone" = pct,
                                     "count_t_clone" = count,
                                     "count_donor" = donorCount)
full2 <- full %>% left_join(t_clones_slim, by = "key")
full2 <- full2 %>% mutate(drop_pct = 100 * count / donor_drop_count)
full3 <- full2 %>% filter(!is.na(key)) %>%
                   mutate(tdrop_ratio = drop_pct / pct_t_clone,
                          log_tdrop_ratio = log10(drop_pct / pct_t_clone))

full3$three_chain <- as.factor(full3$three_chain)



full3$three_chain <- as.factor(full3$three_chain)


full3 %>% ggplot(aes(three_chain, log_tdrop_ratio)) + 
                   geom_violin(aes(fill = three_chain, color = three_chain), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.2) +
                   geom_boxplot(aes(color = three_chain), fill = "white", outlier.size = -1, lwd = 0.3, width = 0.2, fatten = 5) +
                   labs(x = "Type of clone", y = "TCR enrichment score\nin empty droplets") +
                   stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("FALSE", "TRUE")), tip.length = 0, size = 1.7, bracket.size = 0.2) +
                   theme_bw() + 
                   theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
                         axis.title = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
                         legend.position = "none",
                         panel.grid = element_blank(),
                         panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.7, color = "black"),
                         axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
                         axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 0.5)),
                         axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, size = 8, color = "black"),
                         axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 0.5)),
                         axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05, "cm")) +
                   scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkolivegreen", "magenta4")) +
                   scale_color_manual(values = c("darkolivegreen", "magenta4")) +
                   scale_x_discrete(labels = c("2 TCR chain", "3 TCR chain")) +
                   scale_y_continuous(guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE), limits = c(-2.1, 3.5))


tggsave("/home/ecb86/Desktop/ECLIPSE/revisions/figures/s4i.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 2.3, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```
